html: אדן (m. disputed; (1) cf. As. [adannu] firm, strong; adv. adanniš, strongly, exceedingly DlW > (2) Fü. (a) make firm, fasten (cf. عدن) whence אֶדֶן; (b) determine, command, rule, whence אָדוֹן; (3) Thes Add., MV al. (a) intr. be under, low, inferior (cf. דּוּן, دان), whence אֶדֶן; (b) tr. put under command, rule over (cf. דִּין) whence אָדוֹן; v. also (4) LagM i. 102, אָדוֹן fr. ادى ).
